design_language.theme: void-paper + dotted ring hub + tracked type; minimal dark/optional light
principles: conserve focus and user approval authority
no secrets or raw private transcripts in browser

availability_levels.pr3_draft_projection: field available in unmerged draft CompanyOS PR #3; not production validated
availability_levels.needs_adapter: authoritative source exists or is proposed, but no verified CompanyOS adapter
availability_levels.fixture_only: no authorized live source; synthetic test fixture only

components.label: Factory lane matrix
components.question: Which workers are actually progressing?
components.truth_guard: heartbeat is not work completion; active, stale, and unknown distinct

components.label: Source freshness strip
components.question: Which claims are grounded or missing?
components.truth_guard: optional/missing source never becomes healthy/zero

components.label: Fleet & capacity offers
components.question: Where can eligible work run?
components.truth_guard: no placement authority; sessions sticky, unknown quota not zero

components.label: Host disk/security condition
components.question: What physical risk blocks the factory?
components.truth_guard: status derives only from current metadata; no content/credentials

components.label: Execution trace path
components.question: Where did an intent stop?
components.truth_guard: trace ids may be incomplete; control.available does not prove admission or success

components.label: Observed metric strip
components.question: What was measured?
components.truth_guard: raw row sums are provisional; block verified/savings claims pending canonical receipts #150

components.label: Objective progress rings
components.question: Which verified objective is at risk?
components.truth_guard: no synthetic percentages; declare denominator, horizon, proof and unknown coverage

components.label: Human attention queue
components.question: Which decision needs a person now?
components.truth_guard: preparation is not approval; never mutate from a generated widget

components.label: Canonical outcome & accounting
components.question: Which outcomes truly improved?
components.truth_guard: latest negative wins over stale positive; count each trace once; estimated != measured

components.label: Meaningful delta ribbon
components.source_contract: z0 EventLog / canonical source change receipts
components.question: What changed since I was away?
components.truth_guard: dedup/replay idempotence and freshness; no focus theft

components.label: Evidence & provenance lens
components.question: Why do we believe this?
components.truth_guard: show observed/provisional/contradicted/stale/verified separately, redact private data

components.label: Quota & reset window
components.question: Which free eligible capacity expires soon?
components.truth_guard: minute/day buckets never collapse; unknown not free; no paid spill assertion from estimates

components.label: Memory and indexing coverage
components.source_contract: CompanyOS AgentsView metadata + ctx coverage audit #144
components.question: Can our agents actually recover relevant history?
components.truth_guard: AgentView-readable is not ctx-indexed/model-visible/used; OMP omissions explicit

components.label: Architecture reuse evidence
components.question: Should we reuse or write new code?
components.truth_guard: draft contract not enforced; REUSE/EXTEND/NOVEL/OBSERVE without authority

components.label: Local cognition candidates
components.question: Which local model was tested and with what confidence?
components.truth_guard: timeouts carry waited time and uncertainty; shadow does not imply active routing

components.label: End-to-end latency waterfall
components.question: What actually dominates UX latency?
components.truth_guard: wall vs sum separated; unknown coverage, 402/429/approvals represented

components.label: Free-only fallback trace
components.question: Why did the route fail over?
components.truth_guard: draft not deployed; blocking opt-in context paths cannot be labeled 0ms

components.label: Checkpoint/recovery state
components.question: What can safely resume after an interruption?
components.truth_guard: checkpoint created != live host recovery; started->unknown; no replay authority

components.label: Dependency and reviewer graph
components.question: Which blocker has largest fan-out?
components.truth_guard: PR/issue status not verified objective; human authorship retained

components.label: Voice-and-point intent composer
components.question: Can we explore by asking a question?
components.truth_guard: capture scope and consent; never auto-send or infer approval

components.label: Ephemeral comparison workspace
components.question: Can I inspect a hypothesis without altering live state?
components.truth_guard: hypothetical != observed; last good view always restorable

components.label: Revenue/cohort funnel
components.question: Why did conversion or retention change?
components.truth_guard: no fabricated business metrics; source access/consent required
